verdict.rationale: The SDK is a developer library, not an end-user app with built-in insight features. It does give developers the parts to build agents that turn a user's data into AI-generated insights: FileSearchTool retrieves from your OpenAI vector stores, CodeInterpreterTool runs analysis code in a sandbox, function tools and MCP connect other data sources, and streaming shows partial responses to end users. Missing for 10: any ready-made in-product insight or suggestion feature (e.g., in the Traces dashboard), documented data-analysis or insight use cases, and hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
